nom: belif Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: One reviewer with super oily skin, who normally avoids hydrating products, reports this toner has really helped her skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls hers super dry and another with dry, sensitive skin, report this is the first toner that actually leaves their skin feeling moisturized rather than stripped.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin leaning dry, including one whose skin is also mature and sensitive and prone to breakouts, call this the best toner for their skin type after other toners irritated them, caused breakouts, or left a residue.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with sensitive, acne-prone skin, report no irritation or blemishes despite initial hesitation; the toner does contain fragrance, and one reviewer specifically advises fellow sensitive-skin users to be cautious trying it for that reason.
segments.mature: One reviewer whose skin is dry, combination, mature, sensitive and prone to breakouts calls this the best toner she has found for her skin type, unlike others that irritated her or left residue.

concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority of reviewers, including several with dry skin, report this is unusually hydrating for a toner and does not dry out or strip their skin at all; however, one reviewer warns that alcohol denat, the third listed ingredient, can cause excessive dryness and disrupt the skin barrier, and recommends dry-skin users avoid it, while two others found the hydration insufficient for their liking given the price.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer warns that alcohol denat, the third listed ingredient, is known to cause excessive dryness, disrupt the skin's natural barrier, and potentially trigger breakouts, irritation and redness, recommending dry-skin users avoid this toner as a precaution; no reviewer who actually used the product reports these adverse effects themselves.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report the toner helps prevent or calm breakouts, including one who notices she breaks out when she skips it and another with acne-prone skin who has never had a blemish from it; one credits its pH balance specifically for calming her breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the toner draws oil and dirt out of the pores effectively, though this is the only reviewer to describe an oil-clearing effect directly.

aspects.libelle: Fragranced, noticeably strong for some users
Small amount goes a long way, lasts months
Pricey relative to hydration delivered, per some
Preps skin so other products absorb better

extraits.texte: The 3rd listed ingredient is "Alcohol Denat."… while yes this ingredient can be used for *some* toners, it can cause excessive dryness and disturb the natural barrier on your skin. It can also cause breakouts, skin irritation, and redness. With this being the 3rd ingredient, stay away from this toner if you have dry skin. There are some good products from this brand but just stay away from this one. This is a miss for sure.
I have super oily skin so i tend to stray away from hydrating products but this has really helped my skin! Super hydrating and smells good

I have dry sometimes dry/combination mature skin thats very sensitive and prone to breakouts. Toners are a a necessary step in my morning and evening skincare routine. I've tried many toners and all of them either irritated my skin; causes breakouts; or left a film/residue. This toner doesnt do any of that. It does the job and preps your face for the next steps. The best toner for my skin type.

extraits.titre: Only toner i will ever need
extraits.texte: I love this toner. Several years ago I tried many toners and none really did anything. I then decided to try Belief Toner since I am obsessed with the aqua bomb moisturizer. Five years later, I cannot stop buying this and I hope it's never discontinued. This helps hydrate my skin but it's the best for prepping my skin to help absorb my other product (which I had an issue with before incorporating this product into my skincare routine). I have combo skin leaning on the dryer side. Highly recommend giving it a try! p.s There is fragrance in this product so if you have sensitive skin you might want to be cautious trying this.

I have tried so many hydrating toners. This is the most hydrating toner I've ever tried. For me, it is instant hydration and feels so soft. I don't know how to explain it but almost like a silky smooth feeling? I tried a sample of it and went out and bought it instantly the next day!! I would definitely recommend this. I have dry, sensitive skin.

i use this in the am + pm after cleansing. i notice i break out whenever i skip using this or only use it once a day. i've tried many toners but none of them do it for me like this one. i find many feel like an astringent and dry out my skin but this one feels good on my skin. lasts me a few months. holy grail toner.
This toner not only cleanses and moisturizes, it also perks up your skin and tightens it. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this never caused me a blemish. I will buy this over and over again!

reserve: With only about 20 unique reviews (two entries share identical text), this is a small sample, so patterns here, especially the single ingredient-safety warning, are not yet corroborated by many independent users.
